title: Kafka west backup: topic round-trip
description: Captures a topic to a node-local .jsonl, then replays it into a verify topic and counts the produce->consume round-trip.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: BackupId + record count + node-local destination; restore replays into a verify topic and matches the count

whatProves: backup/restore is a genuine produce->consume round-trip over mTLS.
